ratings.3: Meets the case requirements with minor defects

pass_rule: Every applicable dimension >=3; no critical failure; objective checks verified. A rating is a reviewer judgment supported by artifact locations, not a calibrated probability or perfection score.
independence: Separate invocation and reviewer receipt required; role labels alone do not establish it.
host_scope: Record actual provider/host/version/tools and permission denials. Local plugin-dir tests do not certify marketplace installation.
file_checks: Actual parse and render inspection required for requested exports; mark unexecuted checks pending.
